title: 图表写作：区分数字与解释
subtitle: 原创写作短练习 · 参考答案不唯一
body: 虚构数据：图书馆工作日晚间访问量从300人次增至420人次。写一个描述并谨慎解释变化的段落。不要推断用户人数、学习效果或因果。
sample: The figures show that recorded evening visits to the library increased from 300 to 420 on weekdays, a rise of 120 visits. This suggests that the building was used more frequently during the period measured. It does not necessarily mean that 120 additional individuals visited, since one person may have entered several times. Nor does the increase by itself explain why attendance changed. Longer opening hours, a busier academic period, or other factors could be relevant. Further information would be needed before linking the change to a particular policy or claiming an improvement in learning.
analysis: 用 suggests / could 保留解释的不确定性。
观察和可能原因分开，不把相关当因果。

source.title: 77 原创写作任务与示例 · 非真题，非评分标准

title: 支持一个公共空间改进
subtitle: 原创写作短练习 · 参考答案不唯一
body: 写一个论证段：支持社区图书馆增加安静座位。说明一项好处、一项实际限制以及可行的小规模试行办法。
sample: The community library should consider adding a small number of quiet seats. Residents who share crowded homes may otherwise struggle to find somewhere to read or complete important forms. However, creating a quiet area could reduce the space available for group activities, which are also valuable. A limited trial would therefore be more useful than immediately changing the whole building. The library could set aside one corner during selected hours and invite comments from different visitors. This would help staff understand demand and practical difficulties before deciding whether a larger change is justified.
analysis: 主张后给具体使用情境，避免只说“有很多好处”。
承认小组活动也有价值。
用试行回应限制，让建议可操作。

source.title: 77 原创写作任务与示例 · 非真题，非评分标准

title: 提出一个有弹性的学习计划
subtitle: 原创写作短练习 · 参考答案不唯一
body: 写一个段落，解释你会如何在繁忙一周安排英语练习。包括一个主要任务、一个较轻替代任务、一次复盘。不要承诺每天状态相同。
sample: During a busy week, I would choose one main reading task and divide it into manageable parts. On a day with enough time, I could read a passage, answer its questions, and check the evidence for each answer. If my schedule changed, I would instead revisit a few familiar phrases and note where to continue. At the end of the week, I would review which activities were useful and adjust the remaining work. The purpose of the plan would be to support practice under real conditions, rather than to preserve a timetable that no longer fits.
analysis: 用条件句说明不同情境，不把计划写成绝对承诺。
任务有可见动作：阅读、作答、核对、续学。
复盘调整内容而非惩罚没完成的天数。

source.title: 77 原创写作任务与示例 · 非真题，非评分标准

title: 礼貌反馈一次服务问题
subtitle: 原创写作短练习 · 参考答案不唯一
body: 写给活动组织者：路线说明没有注明台阶，导致部分访客不便。描述问题，提出改进，避免替所有访客表达意见。
sample:
Dear Organisers,
Thank you for arranging the neighbourhood tour. I enjoyed learning about the area, but I would like to suggest one improvement to the route information. The notice did not mention the steps near the first stop, which made planning difficult for a visitor in our group. It would be helpful to indicate any steps and provide details of an alternative route where one is available. A simple map could allow people to choose what suits them before arriving. I hope this suggestion will be useful when preparing future events.
Best wishes,
Lin
analysis: 先具体描述，不使用“所有人都很不满”等无依据概括。
建议聚焦路线信息和可用替代路。
礼貌语气并不妨碍明确指出问题。

source.title: 77 原创写作任务与示例 · 非真题，非评分标准

title: 技术便利与个人选择
subtitle: 原创写作短练习 · 参考答案不唯一
body: 写一段讨论：推荐系统能帮我们发现内容，但是否应替我们作决定？给出用途与限制，并得出有条件的结论。
sample: Recommendation systems can make exploration easier by introducing books, music, or courses that we might otherwise miss. Their suggestions can be especially useful when the available choices are overwhelming. However, a recommendation based on previous behaviour may not reflect a person's current purpose. Someone who usually reads fiction may now need information for a specific project. We should therefore treat suggested content as a starting point and inspect whether it meets our needs. The value of the system lies in reducing the effort of discovery while leaving room for comparison, curiosity, and an informed personal choice.
analysis: 开头承认具体好处；转折后说明何时失配。
用一个阅读情境支撑限制。
结论不写“技术全好或全坏”，而给使用方式。

source.title: 77 原创写作任务与示例 · 非真题，非评分标准

title: 解释一项调整的理由
subtitle: 原创写作短练习 · 参考答案不唯一
body: 给学习小组写一则通知：本周讨论改为短文，参与者可只分享读过的部分。说明原因、安排和剧透边界。
sample: This week's reading discussion will focus on a short article instead of the planned novel. Several members have a particularly busy schedule, and we would like everyone to have a manageable way to participate. Please read as much as you comfortably can and bring one question or observation. There is no need to apologise for an unfinished section. We will discuss the first half together before asking whether anyone would like to continue further. This should make the conversation easier to join while avoiding unexpected spoilers for people who have not reached the ending.
analysis: 清楚写改了什么、为何改、要准备什么。
不要求成员公开私人忙碌原因。
讨论进度先征询，说明照顾不同阅读位置。

source.title: 77 原创写作任务与示例 · 非真题，非评分标准

title: 描述一次修订过程
subtitle: 原创写作短练习 · 参考答案不唯一
body: 写一段介绍你如何改进一篇论证不清的文章：保留初稿、明确主张、补证据、记录修改理由。
sample: When revising an unclear argument, I would first keep a copy of the original draft. I would then identify the main claim and check whether each paragraph helps the reader understand or evaluate it. A statement that goes beyond the available evidence may need to be narrowed rather than made more confident. Where a connection is missing, an example or explanation could be more useful than another decorative phrase. Finally, I would record the reason for the most important changes. Comparing the two versions would help me learn from the revision instead of simply replacing one text with another.
analysis: 过程有先后，但每一步还需解释目的。
证据弱时可以缩小主张，不必只强化语气。
记录理由可帮助迁移到下一次写作。

source.title: 77 原创写作任务与示例 · 非真题，非评分标准

title: 评价一个有限样本的结论
subtitle: 原创写作短练习 · 参考答案不唯一
body: 虚构研究访问12名自愿参加者，其中8人喜欢线上讨论。写一段说明可得结论与不可得结论。
sample: In this small interview group, eight of the twelve volunteers said that they preferred online discussion. Their comments may help researchers understand why this format suits some learners. However, the result should not be presented as the preference of all students. Volunteers may differ from people who chose not to participate, and one small group cannot capture every learning context. It would be useful to examine the reasons given and invite a wider range of participants in a later study. The interviews offer a starting point for further questions, rather than a complete answer about the best discussion format.
analysis: 8/12是样本描述，不直接推广全体学生。
样本小与自愿参与是不同限制。
仍保留访谈的价值：理解原因、发展问题。

source.title: 77 原创写作任务与示例 · 非真题，非评分标准

title: 向朋友推荐一次实用活动
subtitle: 原创写作短练习 · 参考答案不唯一
body: 给朋友写短邮件推荐免费的自行车基础维护课。说明能学什么、不能替代什么、可不带自行车参加。
sample:
Hi Mei,
I found a bicycle maintenance session that you might enjoy. It is free and covers basic checks of tyres, brakes, and seat height. You can attend without bringing your own bicycle because a demonstration model will be available. The session is intended to help beginners recognise simple issues, rather than qualify them to carry out every repair. If a serious fault is found, the organisers will suggest getting professional help. I thought this would suit your interest in understanding your bicycle better. Let me know if you would like me to send the booking details.
Best,
Lin
analysis: 推荐理由联系朋友兴趣，不承诺活动能解决所有问题。
准确说明基础课程边界。
不编造具体日期地址，缺少的信息可随后提供。

source.title: 77 原创写作任务与示例 · 非真题，非评分标准

title: 公共服务为什么需要纸质入口
subtitle: 原创写作短练习 · 参考答案不唯一
body: 写一个讨论段：在线预约方便，但保留纸质或现场入口为什么仍有意义？提出一个管理上的注意点。
sample: Online booking can save time, but it should not be the only way to access every public service. A person may have no suitable device, limited data, or difficulty understanding an unfamiliar form. A paper or in-person option can provide another route without requiring them to explain private circumstances. However, separate booking channels must be coordinated so that two people are not promised the same place. Staff should therefore use a shared record and clear procedures. The aim is to offer different ways into the same service while keeping the information consistent and the process understandable.
analysis: 理由具体，避免把群体概括为“不会技术”。
承认双渠道需同步管理。
结尾回到同一服务的公平可及。

source.title: 77 原创写作任务与示例 · 非真题，非评分标准

title: 写一个不夸大的活动总结
subtitle: 原创写作短练习 · 参考答案不唯一
body: 虚构活动：20人参加维修工作坊，修好9件物品，还有4件转专业人员。写一段总结，不声称已减少多少碳排放。
sample: Twenty people attended the repair workshop, where nine items were repaired and four others were referred to specialists. Participants also had opportunities to ask how common faults could be identified safely. These results show what the event achieved directly, but they do not establish its total environmental impact. We did not measure how long the repaired items would remain in use or what people would otherwise have purchased. For a future event, we could collect voluntary follow-up comments and improve the guidance available for cases beyond the volunteers' skills. The workshop provided useful practical help while revealing areas for further support.
analysis: 准确复述人数与物件数，不能混为同一单位。
没有环境测量就不写减排结论。
未来建议回应未知，不把未知写成失败。

source.title: 77 原创写作任务与示例 · 非真题，非评分标准

title: 比较买新与维修
subtitle: 原创写作短练习 · 参考答案不唯一
body: 写一个段落比较修理旧设备与购买新品。至少考虑成本之外的一个因素，避免“总是维修更好”的结论。
sample: Repairing an old device can be worthwhile when the fault is limited and suitable parts are available. It may extend the life of an object the owner already understands. However, the repair cost is not the only consideration. Safety, reliability, and access to clear instructions also matter. A device with sealed components may be difficult to service, while a replacement could introduce different costs or compatibility problems. Before deciding, the owner should obtain a realistic description of the fault and the available options. The better choice depends on the particular device and circumstances, rather than a universal preference for either old or new.
analysis: 按共同维度比较，不各写一堆不对应的优点。
给条件：故障、备件、安全、兼容性。
结论保持条件性而非绝对二选一。

source.title: 77 原创写作任务与示例 · 非真题，非评分标准

title: 把抽象主张写具体
subtitle: 原创写作短练习 · 参考答案不唯一
body: 以“Clear information can improve everyday services”为主旨写段落。用一个标识或通知的具体例子论证，不堆积形容词。
sample: Clear information can improve everyday services by helping people act with less uncertainty. Consider a printer with a sign that merely says assistance available. A new user may still wonder whether help costs money or where to find a staff member. A revised sign could explain that someone at the nearby desk can demonstrate the first step for free. An arrow would make the location easier to identify. The improvement comes from answering the questions people actually have, not from adding more impressive language. Observing whether visitors still hesitate would help staff decide if further clarification is needed.
analysis: 主旨后马上给情境；不靠“非常重要”重复主张。
明确旧说明缺什么、新说明补什么。
可观察行为是下一步核查，而非自动证明成功。

source.title: 77 原创写作任务与示例 · 非真题，非评分标准

title: 提出一项小规模试行
subtitle: 原创写作短练习 · 参考答案不唯一
body: 写给学生会一段提案：试行两周的安静通知设置。说明默认值、用户控制和如何评估，不能只把通知数减少当成功。
sample: I suggest a two-week trial of quieter notification settings for the student app. Routine summaries could appear inside the app, while important reminders would remain available to anyone who chooses to enable them. The settings should be explained clearly and be easy to change. At the end of the trial, we could invite voluntary comments about whether users missed useful information or felt less interrupted. The number of messages sent would be worth recording, but it would not be enough to judge success on its own. The trial should help us understand the balance between useful support and unnecessary distraction.
analysis: 试行期限属于本题设定，不是科学最优周期。
默认安静同时保留控制。
评估包含错过重要信息的代价。

source.title: 77 原创写作任务与示例 · 非真题，非评分标准

title: 从现象到审慎结论
subtitle: 原创写作短练习 · 参考答案不唯一
body: 虚构观察：更换教室家具后，一些学生说讨论更方便。写一个段落，说明这一反馈支持什么，尚未证明什么。
sample: After the classroom furniture was rearranged, some students reported that small-group discussion had become easier. This is useful feedback about their experience of the space. It does not, by itself, demonstrate an improvement in learning outcomes or prove that every student preferred the new arrangement. The tasks may also have changed, and quieter learners may have different needs. A sensible next step would be to observe several kinds of activity and invite comments from a broader range of students. The room could then retain flexible areas for discussion as well as places suited to individual work.
analysis: 反馈支持体验描述，不能直接变成学习效果。
提出可能同时变化的因素。
下一步与不同活动、不同需求相对应。

source.title: 77 原创写作任务与示例 · 非真题，非评分标准

title: 感谢并说明具体收获
subtitle: 原创写作短练习 · 参考答案不唯一
body: 写一封感谢导师的短邮件，具体说明一次反馈如何帮你修改文章，以及你准备如何独立应用。避免只有泛泛赞美。
sample:
Dear Professor Lee,
Thank you for your comments on my draft. Your question about the connection between my example and the main claim helped me see where the argument was unclear. I have revised that paragraph by explaining the link and removing a sentence that introduced an unrelated point. I also kept a short note about why I made those changes. For my next essay, I plan to check the purpose of each paragraph before polishing individual sentences. I appreciate the way your feedback gave me a concrete next step while leaving room to make the revision myself.
Best wishes,
Lin
analysis: 具体提及反馈内容、改了什么、下次怎么用。
不虚构评分提升或考试结果。
语言礼貌而非夸张赞美。

source.title: 77 原创写作任务与示例 · 非真题，非评分标准

title: 解释为什么记录需要背景
subtitle: 原创写作短练习 · 参考答案不唯一
body: 写一个论证段：为什么学习时长或运动步数旁的简短情境备注有用？至少说明一项数据边界。
sample: A brief contextual note can make a personal record easier to interpret. For example, a short study session may reflect an unusually busy day rather than a lack of interest. Similarly, an activity tracker may count some movements inaccurately during a long journey. Recording the relevant circumstances does not make the numbers perfectly accurate, but it can prevent an unsupported conclusion. The record becomes more useful when it helps a person ask what happened and what adjustment might help next. It should therefore support reflection and planning, rather than serve as a complete measurement of effort, ability, or personal worth.
analysis: 用具体反例说明同一数字可能不同含义。
备注帮助解释，不等于修正测量准确度。
结尾明确记录用途边界。

source.title: 77 原创写作任务与示例 · 非真题，非评分标准

title: 写一个承认限制的建议结尾
subtitle: 原创写作短练习 · 参考答案不唯一
body: 为文章写一个结尾段：城市应改善步行体验，但预算和不同需要带来限制。提出可执行的下一步，不重复空泛口号。
sample: Improving walking conditions does not require the city to assume that one route or design will suit everyone. With limited resources, officials could begin by identifying obstacles reported by residents and checking the busiest connections to essential services. Clearer crossings, places to rest, and accurate route information may address different difficulties. A small set of changes should be reviewed with the people who use those streets before the programme expands. Such an approach would not solve every transport problem at once, but it would provide a practical way to learn which improvements deserve further attention and investment.
analysis: 结尾收束立场并给下一步，不再引大量新论点。
预算限制对应分步实施。
避免“解决所有问题”等无法支持的保证。

source.title: 77 原创写作任务与示例 · 非真题，非评分标准

title: 说明如何回到一项中断的任务
subtitle: 原创写作短练习 · 参考答案不唯一
body: 写一个温和实用的说明段：给中断几天后重返学习的人建议。保留既有记录，选一个小步骤，不排名、不要求补完全部旧计划。
sample: Returning to study can begin with a small point of continuity. Open the last saved note and choose one question that still matters to you. Try answering it before checking the material, then decide whether to continue or stop for today. There is no need to complete every task that belonged to an earlier plan, because that plan may no longer fit your circumstances. Keep the useful parts of your record and adjust the next step to the time available now. A short, purposeful session can provide a clear place to resume without turning your absence into another obligation.
analysis: 语气尊重自主选择，不用羞辱和比较。
步骤具体：开笔记、选问题、先答、核对。
短练习是可用入口，不宣称能替代所有学习。

source.title: 77 原创写作任务与示例 · 非真题，非评分标准

title: 社区图书馆的新用途
subtitle: 原创汉译英短段 · 多种译法均可
body: 社区图书馆不仅提供书籍，也为居民提供交流和学习的空间。一些图书馆开始出借常用工具。这样的服务可能帮助人们减少不必要的购买，但也需要可靠的检查和维护。
sample: Community libraries provide not only books but also spaces where residents can meet and learn. Some have begun lending commonly used tools. Such services may help people avoid unnecessary purchases, but they also require reliable inspection and maintenance.
analysis: not only...but also 连接相同层级成分。
“可能”应保留为 may，不改成必然结果。
维护用 maintenance，检查用 inspection。

source.title: 77 原创翻译练习与参考译文 · 非历年真题

title: 先理解任务再制订计划
subtitle: 原创汉译英短段 · 多种译法均可
body: 制订学习计划之前，明确自己想完成什么通常比列出很长的任务清单更有用。计划还应允许调整，因为每天可用的时间和精力不一定相同。
sample: Before making a study plan, it is often more useful to clarify what you want to accomplish than to create a long list of tasks. The plan should also allow adjustments, since the time and energy available may vary from day to day.
analysis: 比较结构 more useful to...than to... 保持平行。
“通常”用 often，避免绝对化。
available 后置修饰 time and energy。

source.title: 77 原创翻译练习与参考译文 · 非历年真题

title: 保留不同版本
subtitle: 原创汉译英短段 · 多种译法均可
body: 修改文章时，保留初稿可以帮助我们理解变化。仅有一篇更流畅的终稿，并不能说明作者已经学会如何改进论证。记录修改理由可能更有帮助。
sample: Keeping the first draft when revising an essay can help us understand the changes. A more fluent final version alone does not show that the writer has learned how to improve an argument. Recording the reasons for revisions may be more helpful.
analysis: 动名词 Keeping / Recording 可作主语。
alone 对应“仅有”，位置影响语义。
论证用 argument，此处不是争吵。

source.title: 77 原创翻译练习与参考译文 · 非历年真题

title: 观察与解释
subtitle: 原创汉译英短段 · 多种译法均可
body: 河水颜色发生变化是一项观察，而污染可能只是其中一种解释。在取得适当证据之前，不应把一个合理猜测当作已经证实的结论。
sample: A change in the colour of river water is an observation, while pollution may be only one possible explanation. Before obtaining appropriate evidence, we should not treat a plausible guess as a confirmed conclusion.
analysis: while 对照两种概念。
plausible 表看似合理，不等于已证实。
treat A as B 对应“把A当作B”。

source.title: 77 原创翻译练习与参考译文 · 非历年真题

title: 更清楚的公共标识
subtitle: 原创汉译英短段 · 多种译法均可
body: 好的公共标识需要回答人们实际遇到的问题。仅仅放大字体并不总能解决困惑，因为缺少的可能是地点、费用或下一步操作的信息。
sample: Good public signs need to answer the questions people actually have. Simply increasing the font size does not always resolve confusion, because the missing information may concern a location, a fee, or the next action to take.
analysis: not always 是部分否定，不能译为 never。
concern 在此为“涉及”的动词。
the next action to take 用不定式后置修饰。

source.title: 77 原创翻译练习与参考译文 · 非历年真题

title: 线上服务的其他入口
subtitle: 原创汉译英短段 · 多种译法均可
body: 在线预约给许多人带来便利，但并非所有人都有合适的设备或稳定的网络。保留现场或纸质入口，可以让更多人有机会使用同一项服务。
sample: Online booking is convenient for many people, but not everyone has a suitable device or a reliable internet connection. Keeping an in-person or paper-based option can give more people a way to access the same service.
analysis: not everyone 保留“并非所有人”的部分否定。
in-person 表现场办理，不译成 personal。
access 在此可直接作及物动词。

source.title: 77 原创翻译练习与参考译文 · 非历年真题

title: 一个数字不能代表全部
subtitle: 原创汉译英短段 · 多种译法均可
body: 平均通勤时间可以概括一部分信息，但它无法展示每个人的经历。两个地区可能有相同的平均值，却存在非常不同的出行困难。
sample: Average commuting time can summarise part of the information, but it cannot represent every person's experience. Two areas may have the same average while facing very different travel difficulties.
analysis: average 是平均值，不是典型个人。
while 表对比而非必须同时发生。
保留 may，避免把可能情况写成事实。

source.title: 77 原创翻译练习与参考译文 · 非历年真题

title: 实用的反馈
subtitle: 原创汉译英短段 · 多种译法均可
body: 有效的反馈应帮助学习者决定下一步。与其一次列出所有可能的不足，不如指出一个已经奏效的选择和一项值得尝试的改变。
sample: Useful feedback should help learners decide what to do next. Rather than listing every possible weakness at once, it may be more helpful to identify one choice that worked and one change worth trying.
analysis: Rather than 后接动名词，与后面动作形成对照。
worth 后接动名词 trying。
“已经奏效”可用 that worked 定语从句。

source.title: 77 原创翻译练习与参考译文 · 非历年真题

title: 资料的长期保存
subtitle: 原创汉译英短段 · 多种译法均可
body: 把照片扫描成数字文件只是保存工作的开始。我们还需要知道文件放在哪里、谁负责管理，以及未来是否仍然能够打开它们。
sample: Scanning photographs into digital files is only the beginning of preservation. We also need to know where the files are stored, who is responsible for managing them, and whether they can still be opened in the future.
analysis: where、who、whether 并列间接疑问，用陈述语序。
responsible for 后接 managing。
files are stored 与 can be opened 保留被动关系。

source.title: 77 原创翻译练习与参考译文 · 非历年真题

title: 尊重不同的学习节奏
subtitle: 原创汉译英短段 · 多种译法均可
body: 一个友好的学习空间不必要求每个人每天完成相同的任务。它可以提供明确的下一步，同时允许人们根据真实情况调整安排。
sample: A welcoming learning space does not have to require everyone to complete the same tasks every day. It can offer a clear next step while allowing people to adjust their plans to their actual circumstances.
analysis: does not have to 表“不必”，不是 must not“禁止”。
while allowing 表同时兼顾。
circumstances 对应实际处境而非天气。

source.title: 77 原创翻译练习与参考译文 · 非历年真题

title: 维修与设计
subtitle: 原创汉译英短段 · 多种译法均可
body: 产品是否容易维修，往往在设计阶段就已受到影响。可更换的零件和清楚的说明有助于维修，但安全和实际成本仍然需要考虑。
sample: How easy a product is to repair is often influenced at the design stage. Replaceable parts and clear instructions can support repairs, but safety and actual costs still need to be considered.
analysis: How easy...is 构成主语从句，后接主句 is influenced。
replaceable 是“可更换的”。
need to be considered 表需要被考虑。

source.title: 77 原创翻译练习与参考译文 · 非历年真题

title: 小规模试行的价值
subtitle: 原创汉译英短段 · 多种译法均可
body: 在改变整个系统之前，先进行小规模试行可以揭示一些实际困难。然而，试行期间的积极反馈并不保证同样的办法适合所有人。
sample: A small-scale trial before changing the whole system can reveal some practical difficulties. However, positive feedback during the trial does not guarantee that the same approach will suit everyone.
analysis: trial 在此是试行，不是司法审判。
does not guarantee 保留证据边界。
suit everyone 表适合所有人。

source.title: 77 原创翻译练习与参考译文 · 非历年真题

title: 阅读中的熟词生义
subtitle: 原创汉译英短段 · 多种译法均可
body: 认识一个词的拼写并不意味着理解它在每个句子中的含义。上下文、搭配和作者的意图都可能影响我们应当选择哪个义项。
sample: Recognising a word's spelling does not mean understanding its meaning in every sentence. Context, collocation, and the writer's intention may all influence which sense we should choose.
analysis: Recognising 与 understanding 都是动名词。
词汇“义项”可译为 sense。
which sense 后用陈述语序 we should choose。

source.title: 77 原创翻译练习与参考译文 · 非历年真题

title: 让会议更容易准备
subtitle: 原创汉译英短段 · 多种译法均可
body: 提前发送明确的问题，可以给成员更多思考时间。这样的安排尤其有助于那些习惯先安静思考、再表达意见的人。
sample: Sending clear questions in advance can give members more time to think. This arrangement can be especially helpful for people who prefer to reflect quietly before expressing their views.
analysis: in advance 对应提前。
who 引导定语从句修饰 people。
before 后接动名词 expressing。

source.title: 77 原创翻译练习与参考译文 · 非历年真题

title: 鼓励应有具体依据
subtitle: 原创汉译英短段 · 多种译法均可
body: 鼓励可以来自真实的小进步，例如重新理解了一个句子，或在几天后想起一个曾经忘记的词。没有必要把每次尝试都变成公开比较。
sample: Encouragement can come from real, small improvements, such as understanding a sentence more clearly or recalling a previously forgotten word after several days. There is no need to turn every attempt into a public comparison.
analysis: such as 后并列两个动名词。
previously forgotten 为过去分词定语。
There is no need to 表不必要，不是禁止。

source.title: 77 原创翻译练习与参考译文 · 非历年真题

title: 解释一项不确定的结果
subtitle: 原创汉译英短段 · 多种译法均可
body: 更多人参加活动可能是一个值得注意的变化，但仅凭人数无法确定原因。时间、地点和宣传方式的变化都可能发挥作用。
sample: An increase in attendance may be a change worth noticing, but the number alone cannot establish its cause. Changes in timing, location, and publicity may all play a role.
analysis: attendance 可表达参加人数或出席情况。
alone 强调仅凭该数字。
establish its cause 比 prove everyone liked it 更忠实。

source.title: 77 原创翻译练习与参考译文 · 非历年真题

title: 推荐工具的适当位置
subtitle: 原创汉译英短段 · 多种译法均可
body: 推荐工具能帮助我们发现原本可能错过的内容。不过，过去的选择不一定反映当前的需要，因此建议仍应与自己的目的进行比较。
sample: Recommendation tools can help us discover content we might otherwise miss. However, past choices do not necessarily reflect current needs, so suggestions should still be evaluated against our own purposes.
analysis: otherwise miss 表若非如此会错过。
do not necessarily 是不必然，而非绝不。
against 在此为对照标准，不是反对。

source.title: 77 原创翻译练习与参考译文 · 非历年真题

title: 图书与日常生活
subtitle: 原创汉译英短段 · 多种译法均可
body: 阅读空间的价值不仅在于藏书数量，也在于人们能否方便地使用它。合适的开放时间和清楚的服务说明，可能与舒适的座椅同样重要。
sample: The value of a reading space lies not only in the number of books it holds but also in how easily people can use it. Suitable opening hours and clear service information may be just as important as comfortable seats.
analysis: lies in 对应在于。
not only...but also 连接介词宾语，结构对称。
as important as 表同等重要，may 保留可能。

source.title: 77 原创翻译练习与参考译文 · 非历年真题

title: 翻译中的谨慎表达
subtitle: 原创汉译英短段 · 多种译法均可
body: 翻译时，流畅不应以改变原文立场为代价。如果作者只说某种结果可能出现，译文就不应把它写成必然发生。
sample: In translation, fluency should not come at the cost of changing the author's position. If the writer says only that a result may occur, the translation should not present it as something that will certainly happen.
analysis: at the cost of 表以……为代价。
may occur 与 will certainly happen 对照强度。
position 此处是立场。

source.title: 77 原创翻译练习与参考译文 · 非历年真题

title: 重新开始的入口
subtitle: 原创汉译英短段 · 多种译法均可
body: 中断之后，保存下来的问题和笔记可以成为重新开始的入口。我们可以从一个可行的小步骤继续，而不必先补完过去计划中的所有任务。
sample: After an interruption, saved questions and notes can provide a starting point for returning to study. We can continue with a small, manageable step without first completing every task from an earlier plan.
analysis: returning to study 中 to 为介词后接名词 study，也可写 resuming study。
manageable 表可应对、切实可行。
without first completing 保留“不必先补完”。

source.title: 77 原创翻译练习与参考译文 · 非历年真题
